Proposal to Increase 'Ladki Bahin Yojana' Payout

A committee advising the central government has recommended increasing the financial assistance provided under the 'Ladki Bahin Yojana'. The proposal suggests raising the payout amount, though specific details on the new amount or implementation timeline were not provided in the coverage. This potential increase could impact beneficiaries of the scheme.
